policy.note: Theory proofs are Agda (source of truth) rechecked in Rocq and Lean. This ledger records, per theorem, the source leg and each recheck leg, with the route, the axioms and the exact commit of the verification receipt.
policy.grade_note: Grades are recorded, not averaged: no percentages (mathesis §6). A grade must be supported by the legs behind it, and the flags in force must be the flags recorded — see .source.flags_provenance.

theorems.statement: The pipeline's information-losing typing operations are instances of the echo-types fiber Echo f y := Sigma A (lambda x -> f x === y): affine weakening (AffineScript linear is below affine) collapses a distinction, has no section, and refinement erasure is non-injective.
theorems.grade_basis: mathesis §5 Grade 3: type-checks in Agda, has not been translated to an independent foundational system. The Rocq and Lean recheck legs required by PROOF-POLICY §2 are recorded here as open.

assumptions.name: absolute-zero
assumptions.note: A CONSUMER of the estate's proof infrastructure, not a provider of axiom-free ground truth: its README at HEAD reports 115 Qed / 0 Admitted / 61 undischarged axioms, with OND-6 (conditional composition) open by design, and an archive notice (2026-10-10) moving its Coq, Lean 4, Isabelle/HOL and Mizar developments under archive/proofs/. source.escape_hatch_evidence: --safe (the compiler refuses postulates, --injective-type-constructors and the other unsafe pragmas) plus scripts/proof-scan-dangerous.sh and the ledger gate's comment-aware escape-hatch scan, both of which run over these files in the same CI lane.
source.universe_discipline: Declarations live in Agda `Set` (the module has no `Setω`/universe-polymorphic machinery of its own); `--without-K` withholds UIP, so no K axiom is assumed; no `--cubical`, so univalence is neither available nor used. This is the §2.2 'type/universe discipline' record.

related_developments.name: epistemic-types
related_developments.note: Formalises the same object differently from a different premise: `EpistemicTypes.EchoBridge.Echo` is a CERTIFIED RESIDUE (fields `residue` and `certified : Cert residue y`) over a `Retention` record with `observe/retain/Cert/sound`, whereas echo-types' `Echo f y` — the one XP-1 uses — is a fibre `Σ A (λ x → f x ≡ y)`. Neither imports the other. XP-1 says nothing about the certified-residue form, about epistemic-types' warrant transport (`checkerSound`, `proofCannotSupportFalse`, `opaqueNotCertifying`, `verifyReceiptIsGap`), or about its rejection fixture `tests/reject/ForgedResidue.agda`.
related_developments.evidence: read at 5422cd5 on 2026-11-01: src/EpistemicTypes/EchoBridge.agda (header flags `--safe --without-K --cubical-compatible --exact-split --no-sized-types --no-guardedness`), src/EpistemicTypes/ProofTransport.agda, PROOF-STATUS.adoc (36 Agda modules, --no-libraries, zero postulates, --double-check -W error)
related_developments.why_not_an_assumption: XP-1 does not import it, so nothing in the proof rests on it. It belongs here rather than in `.source.assumptions` because that array means 'what this proof rests on', and a related formalisation is not that.

theorems.grade_deviation: mathesis §5 names the Grade 3 configurations parenthetically ('--safe --erasure', or 'Full --cubical'), and neither is exactly what runs here: this proof is checked under '--safe --without-K --cubical-compatible', with --erasure off and full --cubical unused. The later, normative estate policy (metadatastician/standards 3-practice/PROOF-POLICY.adoc §2.1, amended 2026-11-01) fixes that combined invocation as the canonical one, and §5 of mathesis says 'e.g.', so the example flags are illustrative rather than closed. The grade therefore stays 3 on mathesis' own operative clause — it type-checks in Agda and has not been translated to an independent foundational system — and the flag difference is recorded here instead of being paraphrased away.

caveats: echo-types: its own identity claim is OPEN by design (README at b0982c4: 'Positive identity is open ... Criterion 2 is open'). XP-1 relates the pipeline's loss operations to that construction; it discharges nothing of echo-types' claim about itself, and must not be cited as if it did.

absolute-zero: a proof-bearing CONSUMER with 61 undischarged axioms and OND-6 open by design — not axiom-free ground truth. None of those axioms is in this proof's import cone (see source.import_cone), but this record must not be read as saying absolute-zero is axiom-free.

scope: the Rocq and Lean recheck legs are unbuilt, so the theorem is Grade 3. Nothing here says a second kernel checked the statement, and no waiver is claimed — PROOF-POLICY §4 waives a leg only when the statement cannot be expressed in the mapped prover, not when the estate has archived a tool.

epistemic-types: a SIBLING formalisation, not a consumed one. Its `Echo` is a certified residue over a `Retention` record; the `Echo` XP-1 uses is echo-types' fibre `Σ A (λ x → f x ≡ y)`. Neither imports the other, so nothing here supports its warrant-transport results (`checkerSound`, `proofCannotSupportFalse`, `opaqueNotCertifying`, `verifyReceiptIsGap`) or its `ForgedResidue` rejection — and reading XP-1 as covering them would be a category error, not an overstatement.
